Microsoft Visual C++ runtime libraries

The Windows portable package redistributes the official x64 runtime DLLs from
Microsoft Visual Studio VC\Redist\MSVC\*\x64\Microsoft.VC*.CRT.
These Microsoft binaries retain their original signatures and copyright notices.
They are governed by Microsoft Software License Terms, not Grabber's Apache license.

License terms: https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
Redistribution: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
App-local deployment: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/deployment-in-visual-cpp
